updateAssistant.description: Read the current user's provisioned workspace update automation, including paused or retired state.

updateSignal.description: Check upstream, deliver actionable owner inbox notifications, and finish without a model turn.

updateStatus.description: Read cached upstream availability without preparing or applying an update.

checkUpdates.description: Check recorded template sources for upstream changes without modifying workspace content.

installed.description: List the exact template sources recorded in this workspace.

inspectContribution.description: Review selected owned units to suggest back to one installed template.

suggestContribution.description: Push the reviewed units on a contribution branch in their template repository.

prepareUpdate.description: Prepare an exact template update in a separate VCS context, preserving local changes for review.

reviewUpdate.description: Inspect a prepared update and its remaining native VCS conflicts.

readUpdateFile.description: Read the base, local, and incoming versions of a file in a prepared update.

resolveUpdate.description: Resolve one exact native VCS conflict in a template update.

publishUpdate.description: Publish a fully reviewed template update through the ordinary workspace VCS gate.

registry.description: Load the default template registry or a registry URL selected by the user.

resolveSource.description: Resolve one moving workspace source address into an immutable exact pin.

inspect.description: Resolve, acquire, and verify one exact workspace template snapshot.

inspectAuthoring.description: Build a reviewed dependency-aware template plan from protected-main workspace source.

publicationRepositories.description: List writable GitHub repositories for a selected connected account.

authoringSetup.description: Read template identity, upstream, dependencies, and declared publication contents from one workspace state.

publicationVersion.description: Suggest the next stable patch version from all existing repository tags.

authoringUpstream.description: Read the workspace's own template publishing repository, if configured.

authoringParts.description: List protected-main repositories available for snapshot authoring.

reviewPublication.description: Check publication access and compare the exact release with upstream without publishing.

publishAuthoring.description: Revalidate and publish a reviewed workspace template snapshot.
